title: Arcane Relics & Potions - Animation Upgrade Revision 4

items.name: Mana Potion
items.break_description: Deterministic fracture and liquid scatter derived from the approved potion.

items.name: Healing Elixir
items.break_description: A distinct upward restorative energy release and dissolve, without copying the mana potion fracture.

items.name: Arcane Crystal
items.orbit_description: Turn the approved crystal through readable faceted orientations while retaining body volume and its fixed canvas anchor.

items.name: Spell Tome
items.open_description: Animate the replacement tome with a clearly visible external arcane aura and centered rune energy.
items.replacement_base_description: A clearly recognizable thick closed arcane spell tome made from dark violet leather, with a visible pale page block, broad spine, brass corner guards, clasp, and one glowing cyan rune centered on the front cover.

items.name: Alchemist Flask
items.reaction_description: Animate a clearly visible clockwise liquid swirl with moving bubbles inside the flask.

items.name: Ritual Candle
items.smoke_description: A small delicate curl of pale violet-gray pixel smoke rising upward from an empty candle wick, sparse and narrow with generous transparent space.

items.name: Enchanted Wand
items.release_description: A compact cyan-and-violet magical spell burst with a bright core, short rays, and a few tiny particles. It must be a standalone transparent VFX asset with no wand baked into it.
